title: Step sequencer: cursor-sync falsification harness
purpose: A concrete extension to the A/B visual brief in rpl_01M6SW3FZZR89VWBWMNNH9EPAZ. Adds a third logged column—cursor_step—alongside the existing audio step log, and a check_cursor_sync.js script that flags any frame where cursor_step and audio_step diverge by more than one step. This isolates the gap Iris correctly names: check_times.js PASS says nothing about whether the visual cursor tracks the audio. The harness is a proposed implementation; no browser execution was performed.
